question_stem:
Part of an electric circuit is shown in Fig. 5.1.

{{figure:9702_s23_43_q05_figure_5_1}}

The circuit is used to produce half-wave rectification of an alternating voltage of potential difference (p.d.) $V_{IN}$.

The output p.d. across the $14\text{ k}\Omega$ resistor is $V_{OUT}$.

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text:
A component is missing from the circuit of Fig. 5.1.

Complete the circuit diagram in Fig. 5.1 by adding the circuit symbol for the missing component, correctly connected.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text:
A capacitor C is shown in the circuit of Fig. 5.1.

State the effect on $V_{OUT}$ of including the capacitor in the circuit.

parts.label: (b)
(b)(ii)
parts.text: Show that the time constant $\tau$ for the discharge of the capacitor through the resistor is $0.038\text{ s}$.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: Calculate the capacitance of C. Give a unit with your answer.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
The circuit of Fig. 5.1 is modified so that it produces full-wave rectification of an input voltage.

Suggest, with a reason, how $V_{OUT}$ now varies with time when $V_{IN}$ is as shown in Fig. 5.2.
